newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kygnus Sekiyu topper turnaround to start Friday.
newsitem.headline: Kygnus Sekiyu topper turnaround to start Friday.

text.p: Kygnus Sekiyu Seisei said on Thursday that its 70,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit at its Kawasaki plant would close as scheduled for 10 days from Friday for routine maintenance work.
The refiner's secondary refining facilities are already shut for routine maintenance work, a refinery official said.
A catalytic reformer with a capacity of 9,333 bpd was shut on April 1 for checks until April 10, and a second 3,000 bpd catalytic reformer was shut on March 26 for checks until April 13.

A 17,000 bpd gas oil desulphurisation unit was shut on March 25 for maintenance work which lasts until April 13, and a 15,000 bpd kerosene desulphurisation unit was closed on March 27 for checks until April 13, the refinery official said.
Kygnus Sekiyu Seisei is a fully owned subsidiary of Tonen Corp.
